summary: Created page with "'''John Morrison Birch''' (May 28, 1918 – August 25, 1945) was an American military intelligence officer and missionary in World War II. After his death at the hands of Chinese communist forces, Birch became a symbol of anti-communism for the nascent conservative movement in the United States, leading to the formation of the John Birch Society in 1958. The organization has been at the center of numerous controversies and conspiracy theories over the years.  == Controve..."
